from common import *
from backtest.scripts.prepare.prepare_regime_train_chunks import cache_lock, _atomic_json

if __name__=='__main__':
    save_source(__file__)
    root=FEATURE.parents[2]
    paths=[FEATURE,OLD_LABEL,VALID]
    receipt=root/'.references/quantile-n-p50-20261107-v1.json'
    with cache_lock(root):
        journal=root/'.cleanup-journal.json'
        if journal.exists():
            pending={r['manifest'] for r in read(journal)['targets']}
            assert not pending.intersection(map(str,paths))
        assert all(p.is_file() and p.is_relative_to(root) for p in paths)
        value={'owner_experiment':EID,'owner_archive':str(BASE.relative_to(ROOT)),'reference_kind':'retained_research_input','manifests':list(map(str,paths)),'retention_reason':'Frozen shared inputs for equal-count n extension and matched H20 control','release_condition':'Release only after owner explicitly retired and all dependencies checked.'}
        if receipt.exists():assert read(receipt)==value
        else:_atomic_json(receipt,value)
    write(BASE/'docs/cache-reference.json',fingerprint(receipt))
    print('Persistent shared-input reference saved; not a process lease.')
